basic_details.job_title: Fakir Mohan University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Research Assistant, Research Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: Fakir Mohan University has announced 3 temporary vacancies for Research Associate and Research Assistant posts under recruitment 2026. Qualifications for these positions vary by post as specified in the official notification, with consolidated pay of Rs. 50,000 per month for Research Associate and Rs. 20,000 per month for Research Assistant. Eligible candidates must apply offline using the prescribed format given in the notification. Completed applications along with all documents should be sent by post and by email to the Registrar, Fakir Mohan University, Vyasa Vihar, Nuapadhi, Balasore on o

how_to_apply: Download the application form from Annexure I (for Research Associate) or Annexure II (for Research Assistant) as given in the official notification.
Fill out the application form with all required personal and educational details.

Attach required documents including application form, statement of research interests/statement of purpose (around 1000 words) for Research Associate, recommendation letters from referees (optional), and hard copy of preprints/reprints of three best research publications.
Send the completed application by post to the Registrar, Fakir Mohan University, Vyasa Vihar, Nuapadhi, Balasore-756089, Odisha.
Send the application by email to [email protected] on or before 28 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Fakir Mohan University Research Associate at a Glance

rows.details: Bioresource Management and Energy conservation Material Development
Rs. 50,000/- per month for Research Associate; Rs. 20,000/- per month for Research Assistant
Must be less than 30 years of age for Research Assistant; Not stated in the notice for Research Associate

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 3 vacancies available under this project.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in Physics/ Experimental Condensed Matter Physics/ Material Science/ Nanotechnology with at least three publications in Web of Science or Scopus journals. The candidate must have a first class in Bachelor or Master's degree from a recognized university.
At least second class in Master degree in any branch of Chemistry/Material Science/ Environmental Science/Physics/Life Science with 55% marks in aggregate from a recognized University.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Fakir Mohan University Research Associate
content_sections.text: Download the application form from Annexure I (for Research Associate) or Annexure II (for Research Assistant) as given in the official notification. Fill out the application form with all required personal and educational details. Attach required documents including application form, statement of research interests/statement of purpose (around 1000 words) for Research Associate, recommendation letters from referees (optional), and hard copy of preprints/reprints of three best research publications. Send the completed application by post to the Registrar, Fakir Mohan University, Vyasa Vihar, Nuapadhi, Balasore-756089, Odisha. Send the application by email to [email protected] on or before 28 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated through e-mail for interview. No separate hard copy of interview call letter will be dispatched. For the post of Research Associate, the short listed candidates will be asked for a presentation of maximum 10 slides containing 50% their research work and 50% the work to be done in FMU followed by personal appearance before the selection committee.
